args.title: Support decimal commas and period thousands separators in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount to correctly handle European-style number formatting where the period is used as a thousands separator and the comma as a decimal separator (e.g. "1.234,56" or "-12,50"), rather than unconditionally stripping commas and assuming period decimal points.
